name: Monster Shooter Vita
author: RaZorGaToR
description: A native PS Vita port of Monster Shooter (Gamelion, 2012), the top-down twin-stick shooter where a kidnapped kitten is reason enough to clear a planet of monsters. This runs the original ARMv7 Android binary through a so-loader, with the game's own Claw Engine driving vitaGL underneath.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
